notes: The exact mappings below follow the canonical IEEE 1516.1-2025 C++ RTIambassador API header. The test confirms the designator and object/attribute are valid while joined, then checks each declared membership exception after resignation with the connection still open.

requirements.statement: The standard API declares FederateNotExecutionMember for getUpdateRateValue. The test first resolves an adapter-supplied valid update-rate designator while joined, then verifies that exception after resignation while connected.

The standard API declares FederateNotExecutionMember for getUpdateRateValueForAttribute. The test first resolves an adapter-supplied known object and defined attribute under an active named subscription while joined, then verifies that exception after resignation while connected.
